Ever since election night last week, President Donald Trump and his party
haven't been able to hide how demoralized, angry, and horrified they are.
Indeed, they aren't really trying to hide it, with many of the MAGA and
Republican Party elite scrambling to throw one another under the 2026-branded
bus, and furiously scapegoat each other, allowing tensions that were
previously gurgling beneath the surface to erupt into full public display.

It's only been a week of this, and all signs suggest that all the intra-GOP
chaos, feuding, and backstabbing is going to get a lot worse, probably faster
than many of Trump's liberal opponents would have once expected. Put simply:
They're already starting to eat each other alive. And some of them are doing
it on live television.

Prominent Republican operatives and pollsters, GOP lawmakers, and Trump
advisers in and close to the administration are now despondently whispering
amongst themselves about how it will be exceedingly difficult (if not
impossible) for any Republican to win the White House in two years, especially
if Trump's Iran war doesn't end soon, according to various sources with direct
knowledge of the matter. (Many Trump officials, however, have been dooming and
glooming for months that the U.S. president has started yet another "[forever
war](https://zeteo.com/p/new-us-iran-strikes-show-trump-has)," with no end in
sight.)

As **Zeteo** [reported](https://zeteo.com/p/maga-self-immolated-how-
everything) last week, Trump has been livid about the 2026 midterm results,
and his vice president and aspiring heir-to-the-MAGA-throne, JD Vance, has
been telling allies for months how worried he is that the Iran war will ruin
his and other conservatives' hopes in future elections, including the 2028
race. Trump's VP has also privately said the war will destroy the Republican
Party at large, if it doesn't wrap up quickly.

Nearly everyone in the party is sounding the alarm; few, if any, are even
attempting to sugar-coat the situation. As John McLaughlin, one of Trump's
longtime pollsters, bluntly told **Zeteo** : "The Republicans forgot what won
the 2024 election… We need to rebuild." Concurrently, one senior Trump
administration official [added](https://zeteo.com/p/maga-self-immolated-how-
everything): "MAGA self-immolated."
